lines.1: 「Thanks for the call, Subaru. You saved me.」
lines.3: It's a trick people use when meeting an online friend for the first time, too.
lines.4: You arrange for someone to call at a set time, and if you don't like the person you're meeting, you use the phone call as an excuse to say something urgent came up and leave.
lines.5: When she believed me that easily, I felt a little guilty.
lines.6: 「She wants something, right? Probably to lecture you. Putting it off might save you for now, but I don't think it'll change anything.」
lines.8: 「Give it a couple days, and time will sort everything out.」
lines.10: She did say she wanted to take her time talking after school.
lines.12: I wasn't good with that piercing gaze of hers, like it could see straight into my heart.
lines.13: Talking to her made me feel pressured, too.
lines.17: 「What's wrong? Pick the wrong choice in a dating sim and make the girl hate you?」
lines.18: 「Or did a real girl say something nasty to you?」
lines.21: Eh, best to leave him alone.
